task: Learning-rate response temporal kernel validation: does the A0O-validated LR response have a stable decay timescale; build the theory bridge from short-term response to long-term training gain.

perturbation.structure: IMPULSE: u applied at optimizer step t ONLY (step 1 of the replay); steps t+1..t+64 run the frozen native AdamW schedule (set_native_micro_lr resets lr every micro-step, so the pulse reverts natively at step 2). This differs from A0O's PERSISTENT schedule input; A0O remains untouched (read-only).

state_and_stream.stream_content_recipe: batch_seed = derive_stream_seed(stream_seed, 404); batches = batches_from_train_pool(train_indices(3936), batch_size=4, batch_seed, 128 micro-batches = 64 optimizer steps x accumulation_steps=2). One deterministic permutation prefix per stream; identical across branches (CRN).
state_and_stream.provenance_gate: A0O amendment-A1 pattern: A0K live_manifest event key must exist for stream_event_key(seed, step): 2030/2031 -> own seed, 2037 -> 2032, step -> largest multiple of 10 <= step. Content NOT reused (128 micro-batches > event lookahead); recipe above is authoritative.

tau_grid_note: Dyadic grid mandated by task; no tau may be added/removed/selected based on results.

recorded.rollout_checkpoints: val loss evaluated at every grid tau along the SAME 64-step rollout (RNG-wrapped, no trajectory disturbance); u=0 branch run twice, L0_repeat must equal L0 bitwise (CRN)

analytic.definition: R(tau) = <p_th ENTERING reverse iter 1, lr_1 * e_lr(1)>, where e_lr = -adaptive(c_1) - wd*theta_1 (A0O-validated pure theta-channel pulse, lr_pulse reused from frozen a0o module by import) and p_th is the endpoint cotangent dL/d(theta_{t+tau}) rewound through the frozen A0H15 reverse adjoint (adamw_tangent_step_adjoint + _a0h1._clip_transpose + fp32 HVP at k>=2) over steps k=tau..2. Linearity: impulse response of the same validated tangent system; the ONLY delta vs A0O production code is source placement (contract at k=1 only).

stage1_gate.scope: pooled over all 12 cells x 7 taus (n=84 analytic-vs-FD pairs), plus per-tau breakdown
stage1_gate.precedent: A0O stage-1 gate thresholds, reused frozen

stage2_temporal_law.kernel_primary: R_analytic (validated by Stage 1); R_fd recorded alongside

fits.tool: scipy.optimize.curve_fit, frozen call: maxfev=20000, no bounds
fits.signed: A free sign; fits run on signed R(tau) values as-is
fits.model_comparison: SSE_exp vs SSE_power reported per cell; NO model selection enters any verdict rule (both reported)

memory_metrics.integrated_abs_response: I = sum_{tau in grid} |R(tau)| (dyadic sum, grid fixed)
memory_metrics.half_life: smallest tau where |R(tau)| <= |R(1)|/2, linear interpolation in tau between bracketing grid points; if never halved on grid -> null (reported as not_reached)
memory_metrics.sign_stability: fraction of grid points with sign(R(tau)) == sign(R(1))

stage2_temporal_law.q1: Stable decay timescale? Rule (pre-registered): YES iff median sign_stability >= 5/7 AND median max(R2_exp,R2_power) >= 0.8 AND CV(tau_c exp fit across cells) < 0.5.
stage2_temporal_law.q2: Does the H=4 window carry long-term direction? S4 = sum_{tau in {1,2,4}} R(tau); S64 = sum_{all grid} R(tau). Metrics: sign_agreement(S4,S64) across cells; Pearson(S4,S64) across cells (n=12). Pre-registered reading: sign agreement >= 10/12 AND Pearson > 0 -> H=4 window contains long-term direction information.
stage2_temporal_law.q3: Shared timescale across seeds/stages? Per-cell (tau_c, alpha, half_life, sign_stability) reported by seed and by step; CV(tau_c) across cells with per-group breakdowns; normalized-shape pairwise Pearson median (R(tau)/R(1)). Shared iff CV < 0.5 with no seed group median deviating >2x from pooled median (diagnostic, not selection).

forbidden: no lambda tuning, no optimizer/scheduler change
no delta change, no tau selection based on results, no extra phases/thresholds post-hoc
no model/seed/state selection based on results (all 12 cells reported)
A0O and all earlier frozen artifacts read-only; docs append-only
no GPU work before this contract + live_manifest hash notes exist on disk
outputs: outputs/a0p_lr_temporal_kernel_v01/ (contract/ runs/ analysis/ reports/A0P_REPORT.md hashes/ audit/); code research/src/fr/a0p_lr_temporal_kernel_v01.py + research/scripts/a0p_{run,analyze,audit_pack}_v01.py
